msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia sinu-and-son-29.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a large iced-out cross pendant fully set with white stones with a small gold figure at the centre from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia sinu-and-son-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of an iced-out gothic letter O pendant fully set with white stones on a tennis chain from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia sinu-and-son-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold number 17 pendant in gothic style set with white stones from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia sinu-and-son-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold Cuban link chain set with stones with a small iced house-shaped pendant from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia sinu-and-son-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold signet ring with a gothic letter M fully set with white stones from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
